==About me==

I read the Eye of the World at some point in early 7th grade. Lord of the Rings in 5th grade had solidly transferred me from horse and his boy stories (The Black Stallion etc) onto a literary diet requiring epic fantasy. I'd read Shannara and DragonLance by the time I got into the Wheel of Time and while I started having to wait on installments I started into other writers, such as Tad Williams, Anne McCaffrey, Melanie Rawn, Ursula K LeGuin, Terry Pratchett, Douglas Adams and of course Piers Anthony, and while I naturally love the Harry Potter series, it came along a little too late for me and I didn't read it until college (prior to reading it I was a bit against HP based on some sort of misguided principle?). WoT however, has been the single story that I've grown up always waiting to hear more of.
